This external pressure led me to second-guess not only my thoughts but also my emotional connection to the music I was discussing. In the end, I realized that the joy I once found in sharing my perspective on albums was overshadowed by the fear of backlash, and that’s a heavy burden for anyone. It became clearer to me that my passion for music needed to be expressed in a more personal, less public way, which is something I’m finally starting to embrace.
